summary:
Space Now is a responsive website that helps students and curious readers explore space science through NASA news and credited imagery. We developed a complete web application where visitors can browse topics such as planets, moons, stars and space exploration, search for stories, and follow links to original NASA reports.

The platform imports NASA RSS updates automatically and includes a secure editorial dashboard for creating, editing and publishing articles. Its dark cosmic interface works across desktop and mobile screens, making space content engaging and easy to navigate.

Space Now aims to make NASA resources easier to discover while preserving clear source attribution. By combining accessible summaries with original-source links, it encourages readers to explore scientific discoveries and learn more about the universe.
details:
Space Now is a responsive website that helps students and curious readers explore NASA news and space discoveries. Visitors can search stories, browse topics and follow links to original reports. The backend imports NASA RSS updates automatically, prevents duplicates and provides a secure admin dashboard for managing articles.

We used HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, Express and RSS Parser, with Visual Studio Code for development. Its creative approach combines a cinematic cosmic interface with searchable news and clear source attribution.

The project aims to encourage interest in space science and make NASA resources easier to discover. We considered mobile usability, readability, security, image credits and reliable installation. Local tests passed on Node 22 and Node 26; public deployment and educational impact remain to be evaluated.

Use AI to assisted with code, design, testing and documentation.
